brief.aim: The table was assembled to relate physicochemical measurements to the sensory quality grade, which has 7 observed discrete levels, so it is modeled as multiclass classification of quality with the 11 chemistry features plus color as predictors; there are no identifier-like keys or post-outcome derived columns.
brief.repeated_subjects: No repeated-subject column; each row is an independent wine sample.
brief.unit: One wine sample (physicochemical assay of a single wine)
